items.title: 19.4 Aliphatic organic compounds ke naam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 19.4, PDF pages 41-44.

blocks.text: Qudrat mein karoron organic compounds milte hain aur har saal laakhon naye compounds banaye ja rahe hain. Is liye zaroorat mehsoos hui ke in compounds ke naam un ke structure ke mutabiq rakhe jayein. Is maqsad ke liye IUPAC (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry) ne usool (rules) banaye. Kisi organic compound ka systematic ya IUPAC naam us ke parent hydrocarbon par mabni hota hai. Har naam ke yeh hisse hote hain:
i) Stem ya Root

Stem sab se lambi musalsal (continuous) carbon chain batata hai jis mein functional group wala carbon bhi shamil ho. Functional group wale carbon ko sab se chhota mumkin number diya jata hai. Agar carbon atoms ring mein jure hon to naam “cyclo” se shuru hota hai.
ii) Suffix
Suffix (naam ka aakhri hissa) do qism ka hai:

items: Primary suffix, jise stem ya root ka suffix bhi kehte hain. Yeh batata hai ke parent chain saturated hai (an) ya unsaturated (en ya yn).
Secondary suffix, jise asal functional group ka suffix bhi kehte hain. Yeh compound ka khandani naam (family name) deta hai, maslan -ol, -al, -one.

blocks.text: iii) Prefix
Prefix (naam ka shuru wala hissa) side chain (alkyl group) ya kisi substituent (maslan halo, nitro jaisa functional group) ka naam deta hai, aur saath us carbon atom ka number jis se woh jura ho.

blocks.alt: Chaar shaklon ki zanjeer: peela daira 'Prefix', neela hexagon 'Stem/Root name', neela hexagon 'Primary Suffix (Suffix of Stem/root)' aur peela daira 'Secondary Suffix (Suffix of F.G.)'. Teer Prefix se 'substituent and its position on the parent chain', Stem se 'No. of carbon atoms in the parent chain', Primary Suffix se 'saturation or unsaturation in the parent chain (an, en, yn)' aur Secondary Suffix se 'family name' ki taraf jate hain.
blocks.caption: Systematic (IUPAC) naam ke hisse (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Naam ko baen se daen parhein. Prefix batata hai ke branch ya substituent kaun sa hai aur chain ke kis carbon par hai (maslan 3-methyl, 4-chloro). Stem chain ke carbon ginta hai: meth 1, eth 2, prop 3, but 4, pent 5. Primary suffix batata hai ke chain saturated (an) hai ya us mein double (en) ya triple (yn) bond hai. Secondary suffix family (khandan) batata hai, maslan -ol alcohol, -al aldehyde. Prefix na ho to naam sirf stem aur suffixes se banta hai, maslan butanal.
Agar prefix na ho to systematic naam sirf root aur suffix se banta hai.
Misalein:

blocks.alt: Do hal shuda misalein. Pehli: Cl-CH2-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-H, zanjeer ke carbon baen se 4, 3, 2, 1 numbered, aur naam dabbe mein 4-chloro | but | an | al hisson mein, jin par prefix, stem, suffix of stem aur suffix of F.G likha hai. Doosri: CH3-C(CH3)=CH-CH2-OH, numbered 4, 3, 2, 1, naam 3- methyl | but- | 2-en- | 1-ol, unhi chaar naamon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Misalein: 4-chlorobutanal aur 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol, prefix, stem aur suffixes mein (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab ki ghalati durust).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab pehli misal ki chain ke carbons ko 1 se 4 tak number karti hai lekin naam “4-chloro prop an al” chhaapti hai. Chain mein chaar carbon hain, is liye stem “but” hai aur sahi naam 4-chlorobutanal hai; khaake mein “but” likha hai. Numbering hamesha us sire se shuru hoti hai jo functional group ke qareeb ho: aldehyde mein C=O wala carbon 1 hai, aur alcohol mein OH wala carbon 1.
Upar diye gaye tareeqe ko samne rakh kar ab mukhtalif classes (khandanon) ke naam aik aik kar ke dekhte hain:
1. Alkyl halides (CₙH₂ₙ₊₁X) (–C–X)
IUPAC naam halogenoalkane hai (zyada theek: monohaloalkane, yani aik halogen wala alkane).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab teesri misal ka naam “3-methyl-1-iodobutane” likhti hai. Prefixes alphabet ki tarteeb (alphabetical order) mein likhe jate hain: “iodo” pehle, “methyl” baad mein. Sahi naam 1-iodo-3-methylbutane hai.
2. Alcohols (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O) (–C–OH)
IUPAC naam alkanol hai (alkane ka “e” hata kar “ol”).
3. Aldehydes (CₙH₂ₙO) (–C(=O)–H)
IUPAC naam alkanal hai. Aldehyde ka C=O wala carbon hamesha number 1 hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 3-methylbutanal ke carbon 4 ko “CH₄” chhaapti hai. Chain ke sire wala carbon methyl group, CH₃, hai (CH₄ to khud methane hai): sahi formula CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–C(=O)–H.
4. Ketones (CₙH₂ₙO) (–C–C(=O)–C–)
IUPAC naam alkanone hai. C=O group chain ke andar hota hai, sire par nahi.
5. Carboxylic acid (CₙH₂ₙO₂) (–C(=O)–OH)
IUPAC naam alkanoic acid hai. –COOH wala carbon number 1 hota hai.

blocks.text_alt: H–C(=O)–OH (methanoic acid);  CH₃–C(=O)–OH (ethanoic acid);  CH₃–CH₂–CH(CH₃)–C(=O)–OH (2-methylbutanoic acid)

blocks.text: 6. Acid amides (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁ONH₂) (–C(=O)–NH₂)
IUPAC naam alkanamide hai. N par laga group naam mein “N-” se likha jata hai.
7. Acid halides (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁OX) (–C(=O)–X)
IUPAC naam alkanoyl halide hai.
8. Esters (CₙH₂ₙO₂) (–C(=O)–O–C)
IUPAC naam alkyl alkanoate hai: pehle O se jura alkyl group, phir acid wala hissa “-oate” ke saath.

blocks.text_alt: CH₃–C(=O)–O–CH₃ (methyl ethanoate);  CH₃–C(=O)–O–CH₂–CH₃ (ethyl ethanoate);  CH₃–CH₂–C(=O)–O–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ (propyl propanoate)

blocks.text: 9. Acid anhydrides (–C(=O)–O–C(=O)–)
IUPAC naam alkanoic anhydride hai; do mukhtalif acids hon to dono ke naam likhe jate hain.
10. Ethers (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O) (–C–O–C–)
IUPAC naam alkoxyalkane hai: chhota group “alkoxy” (maslan methoxy) aur bari chain “alkane”.
11. Amines (CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NH₂)
Amines teen qism ki hain:
a) Primary amines (–C–NH₂): IUPAC naam alkanamine hai. NH₂ kis carbon par hai, yeh number se batate hain.
b) Secondary amines (–C–NH–R): IUPAC naam N-alkylalkanamine hai. Nitrogen par laga chhota alkyl group “N-” ke saath likha jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab N-methylpropan-1-amine ko “CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH₂–CH₃” chhaapti hai. Secondary amine ke nitrogen par sirf aik H hota hai (NH₂ ke saath nitrogen ke chaar bond ho jate). Sahi: CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃.
c) Tertiary amines (–C–N(R)–R): agar dono R aik jaise hon to naam N,N-dialkylalkanamine, aur mukhtalif hon to N-alkyl-N-alkylalkanamine hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in naamon ko “Dialkylakanamine” aur “alkyalkanamine” chhaapti hai; sahi spelling N,N-dialkylalkanamine aur N-alkyl-N-alkylalkanamine hai.
12. Alkyl cyanides (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁N) (–C≡N)
IUPAC naam alkanenitrile hai. –CN ka carbon bhi chain mein gina jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab doosri misal ka naam “2-methylpropaneritrile” chhaapti hai; sahi naam 2-methylpropanenitrile hai.
13. Nitroalkanes (CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NO₂) (–C–NO₂)
IUPAC naam nitroalkane hai; NO₂ group prefix “nitro” ki shakal mein aata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab beech wali misal ko sirf “nitropropane” kehti hai. Pura naam 1-nitropropane hai, kyun ke NO₂ carbon 1 par hai; isi se yeh 2-nitropropane se alag pehchana jata hai.
Quick Check 19.3

blocks.prompt: a) In ke systematic naam batayein: i) (CH₃)₃COH ii) CH₃CCl₃ iii) CH₂=CH–CH₂–OH iv) CH₃COC₆H₅ v) CH₂=C(CH₃)COOCH₃
blocks.explanation: i) 2-methylpropan-2-ol; ii) 1,1,1-trichloroethane; iii) prop-2-en-1-ol; iv) 1-phenylethanone (phenylethanone); v) methyl 2-methylpropenoate (methyl 2-methylprop-2-enoate).

blocks.prompt: b) In ke structures banayein: i) 2-methylbutanal ii) propan-2-yl methanoate (kitab mein “prop-2-ylmethanoate”) iii) phenylethanoic acid iv) cyclohexanone v) 3-methylpentanal
blocks.explanation: i) CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CHO; ii) HCOOCH(CH₃)₂; iii) C₆H₅CH₂COOH; iv) chhe carbon ka ring jis ke aik carbon par =O ho (C₆H₁₀O); v) CH₃CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂CHO.

answer_figure.alt: Paanch structural formulas: (i) 2-methylbutanal CH3-CH2-CH(CH3)-CHO; (ii) propan-2-yl methanoate H-C(=O)-O-CH(CH3)-CH3; (iii) phenylethanoic acid, benzene ring-CH2-C(=O)-O-H; (iv) cyclohexanone, chhe konon wala ring jis ke aik kone par =O; (v) 3-methylpentanal CH3-CH2-CH(CH3)-CH2-CHO.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: 2-methylbutanal, propan-2-yl methanoate, phenylethanoic acid, cyclohexanone aur 3-methylpentanal ke structural formulas.
answer_figure.long_description: Har structure ke neeche us ka naam hai. Aldehydes (i, v) mein chain ke aakhir par C=O aur us C par H hai. Ester (ii) mein methanoate wala hissa H–C(=O)–O– hai aur O ke saath propan-2-yl group, CH(CH₃)–CH₃, jura hai. Phenylethanoic acid (iii) mein benzene ring se CH₂ aur phir –COOH group jura hai. Cyclohexanone (iv) chhe carbon ka ring hai jis ke aik carbon par =O hai. Rings ke har kone par aik carbon hai jis par zaroorat ke mutabiq H atoms hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Naam = prefix + stem (root) + primary suffix + secondary suffix.
Sab se lambi chain lein aur us sire se number karein jo functional group ke qareeb ho.
Khandani suffix: -ol, -al, -one, -oic acid, -amide, -oyl halide, -oate, -amine, -nitrile; prefix: halo, nitro, alkoxy.
